question: Can explicitly written causal edge weights be inferred from controlled public action-consequence contrasts, then sparsely repaired after a contradiction while an archived old causal model stays intact, and outperform a fully fitted conventional identical-information structural estimator?
hypothesis: A 4-node lower-triangular linear additive mechanism is identifiable from two matched public contrast levels for each of four intervention variables, and one changed edge can be reconstructed/archived without overwriting old law. An independent fully fitted conventional inverse-response estimator of identical information must match all predictions exactly; the direct programmer has NO expected predictive superiority from algebra alone.
dev_passes: sparse contradiction-gated edge repair/cold return-to-old and nonlinear/nonlocal negatives

protocol.input: Only 4D public matched-exogenous before/after observations for four interventions, two magnitudes each; eight paired witnesses per world, synthetic authored sources ONLY, no original source access.
protocol.family: linear additive lower-triangular 4-node directed causal relations; authored test generator hides A from learner
protocol.changed_law: exactly one chosen direct edge changes per new world
frozen_controls: fully fitted independent exact conventional inverse-response causal estimator from the same eight controlled witnesses
metrics: new-graph reconstructed edge and total-action-response errors
held candidate minus strongest conventional RMSE
false repair rejection for nonlinear contrast or multi-edge drift
fit runtime and checkpoint size (engineering only)
protocol.stop: If comparator ties or beats candidate on identical data or nonlinear/ambiguous data cannot be identified, preserve DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO and do not tune passed-held labels; no new synthetic polynomial expansion, no third development pass.
protocol.negative: Author-created matched exogenous contrast pairs artificially grant controlled counterfactual observations; unavailable in original CausalMBRL without a separately authorized owner protocol. No unknown-world or scientific claims.
